> **Status:** `active` · **Version:** `2.6.0` (November 25, 2026) · **Master Archive Entry:** `0TH-BUILD-007`
> **Author / Curator:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA` · ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648))
> **Dual License:** Dataset, Charts, White Paper & Prose [`CC-BY-4.0`](LICENSE) · Code, Lean 4.35.0 Proofs, Tests & Tools [`Apache-2.0`](LICENSE-CODE)
> **Supported locales:** English (`en-US`, UTF-8)

An open-source, cryptographically audited, multi-format cross-disciplinary research infrastructure cataloging **`1,900` strictly deduplicated unsolved, open, and hard problems** spanning **8 Macro-Pillars × 28 Superdomains × 8 Physical/Formal Substrates × 7 Abstraction Layers (`L0–L6`) × 1,752 subdomains**, wired into **1 biconnected `5,808`-edge knowledge graph** (`0` articulation points, `0` bridges, `0` dangling links, `35.7%` cross-superdomain, `18.7%` cross-pillar), paired with:

- **103 Zero-Mathlib Pure Lean 4.35.0 Formal Invariant & Adversarial-Refutation Theorems** (`72` core module invariants + `12` concrete NonVacuity & boundary witnesses + `10` constructive `AdversarialTests` false-variant refutations + `9` Palomar contract specifications) verified across **6 independent proof kernels** (`lean`, `leanchecker --fresh` / `leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) plus live negative kernel rejection, with constructive axioms strictly within `[propext, Quot.sound]`.
- **11-Page Publication-Grade AMS-LaTeX White Paper** ([`dist/Donahue_2026_unsolved_problems_mega_atlas.pdf`](dist/Donahue_2026_unsolved_problems_mega_atlas.pdf), `0` overfull hboxes, `12/12` live-verified citations with `0` Crossref retractions) + deterministic clean-room [`dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`](dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz) + **DigiCert RFC 3161 Trusted Timestamp** ([`CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr`](CHECKSUMS.sha256.tsr)).
- **Live Interactive Web Atlas & Lean Proof Blueprint:** [https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/) and [Lean 4.35.0 Proof Blueprint DAG](https://0thernes.github.io/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas/blueprint/) (WCAG 2.2 AA accessible, `< 4 MB`).
- **Offline SQLite FTS5 Hybrid RAG (`100.0% MRR@5`, `25/25` top-1)** + **Zero-Dependency Dual-Framed 10-Tool MCP Server** (`mcp_server/server.py`) + **Immutable Karpathy-Style AutoResearch Harness** (`AQS = 97.99`) + **Track B Antihydra (`LOG-002`) Finite Bigint Pilot**.
- **Deep Verification Ladder:** 50-digit `Decimal`/`Fraction` reference oracle (`reference/scoring_oracle.py`), 1,000-example Hypothesis property suite, 2,000-case differential tests, metamorphic & golden snapshots, and **100% (`6/6`) mutation-kill coverage**.

---

## Honest Verification Boundary (Read First)

1. **Zero (`0 / 1,900`) overarching Mega-Atlas open problems are claimed solved or retired.** Our 103 Lean 4.35.0 theorems verify the atlas's *internal* scoring, quadrant/era, taxonomy, finite graph handshaking, deduplication, AutoResearch ratchet, gradient/margin invariants, non-vacuity, and false-variant refutations **only**.
2. **Author-Curated Companion Archive Entries (`0thernes-research-archive`):** Twelve independent companion preprints and formal builds resolve narrowly scoped published sub-conjectures, formalize complexity barriers, or certify discrete model invariants (cataloged transparently in `paper/main.tex` Section 6, `RANKING.md`, and MCP tool `list_author_frontier_contributions`); all are self-published (not externally peer-reviewed) and explicitly keep every overarching Mega-Atlas parent problem **OPEN**.
3. **November 25, 2026 AI Proof Claims:** All `12` Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof-claim targets (`NT-001` Riemann Hypothesis, `NT-002` GRH, `ANL-001` 3D Navier–Stokes, etc.) remain explicitly flagged `ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026` and **officially unretired** pending human-readable exposition and Clay/community consensus.
4. **Editorial Rubric Disclosure:** Quantitative ratings (`difficulty_score`, `tractability_2050`, `civilizational_impact`, `interdisciplinarity_index`) are disclosed AI-assisted editorial estimates — not peer-reviewed consensus measurements. Edit `src/v2_data/`, run `just build`, and argue from the diff!

## 5-Second Lean 4.35.0 Formal Verification

Reproduce the full 103-theorem constructive axiom audit locally in under 10 seconds:

```bash
cd lean
lake build
lake env lean MegaAtlasProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean
```

Verbatim Palomar headline theorem audit from [`results/lean_axioms.txt`](results/lean_axioms.txt) (drift-checked in CI via `scripts/check_readme_axioms.py`):

<!-- LEAN_AXIOMS_START -->
```text
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m1_scoring_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m2_quadrant_and_era_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m3_taxonomy_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m4_graph_and_dedup_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m5_autoresearch_ratchet_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m6_layer_gradient_margin_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m7_nonvacuity_certificate' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.m8_adversarial_refutations' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
'MegaAtlasProofs.Palomar.prove_all_mega_atlas_invariants' depends on axioms: [propext, Quot.sound]
```
<!-- LEAN_AXIOMS_END -->

On Linux with `bubblewrap`, replay all **6 independent proof kernels** (`lean`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) using the exact single-source CI verification script:

```bash
bash scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh   # or: just lean-kernels
```

## Usage

### 1. Quickstart Setup & Demo (Zero API Keys, 100% Offline)

```bash
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas.git
cd unsolved-problems-mega-atlas
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\activate  |  Linux/macOS: source .venv/bin/activate
pip install -e ".[dev]"
python examples/quickstart_demo.py
```

### 2. Offline Hybrid RAG Search & Side-by-Side Comparison

The SQLite FTS5 index auto-builds deterministically in `< 1 s` on first run on a clean clone:

```bash
python rag/query.py "turbulence climate sensitivity" --top 8 --hops 1
python rag/query.py --problem NT-001 --hops 1
python rag/query.py --compare NT-001 CS-001
python rag/query.py --flag ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026 --top 15
```

### 3. Model Context Protocol (MCP) 10-Tool Stdio Server

Connect Claude Code, Antigravity, Cursor, or Gemini CLI directly (zero external MCP SDK required):

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "unsolved-problems-mega-atlas": {
      "command": "python",
      "args": ["mcp_server/server.py"]
    }
  }
}
```

### 4. Full Deterministic Rebuild & Verification (`justfile`)

```bash
just reproduce     # Rebuild exports + pytest + 103-thm Lean audit + AMS-LaTeX paper + SHA-256
just lean-kernels  # Full 6-kernel bubblewrap replay on Linux (lean, leanchecker-paranoid, lean4lean, nanoda, con-leche, con-ron)
just mutate        # 6-mutant semantic mutation testing (100% kill rate)
just bench         # 10-iteration warmed benchmark harness -> docs/benchmarks.md
just audit         # Forensic biconnectivity, Zenodo dry-run & immutable AutoResearch gates
```

## Limitations

See [`LIMITATIONS.md`](LIMITATIONS.md) for the complete analysis and Literal-vs-Metaphor table. Key boundaries:
- Quantitative rubric inputs (`difficulty`, `tractability_2050`, `impact`, `interdisciplinarity`) are solo AI-assisted editorial estimates, not peer-reviewed measurements.
- Pure Mathematics has denser historical registries than applied engineering/humanities (`952` of `1,900` records are flagged `ai-assisted-editorial-synthesis`).
- Lean 4.35.0 certifies discrete structural invariants over bounded inputs; IEEE-754 `log1p` terms are verified differentially against the 50-digit `Decimal` reference oracle (`reference/scoring_oracle.py`).
- Neither this dataset nor the companion white paper has undergone external journal peer review.

# AGENTS.md — Canonical Agent Instructions (`unsolved-problems-mega-atlas`)

> **Build Standard:** `v1.2.0` (`docs/build-standard.md`) · **Atlas Version:** `v2.6.0`
> **Author / Maintainer:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA`, ORCID `0009-0006-8168-9648`, `0_0@0thernes.art`)
> **Dual License:** Data/Figures/White Paper `CC-BY-4.0` (`LICENSE`) · Code/Lean/Tests `Apache-2.0` (`LICENSE-CODE`)

## 1. Repository Map

- `src/v2_schema.py`, `src/v2_data/m01..m11.py` — 1,912 raw authored records deduplicated into `1,900` unique open problems across 8 Macro-Pillars × 28 Superdomains × 8 Substrates × 7 Abstraction Layers.
- `src/v2_loader.py` — Deterministic loader, alias redirection, NetworkX biconnectivity/PageRank/betweenness (`seed=42`, `REFERENCE_YEAR=2026`), and scoring (`CSS`, `Titan`, `Leverage`, `Gradients`, `Margins`).
- `src/v2_charts.py`, `src/v2_export_all.py` — Generates 15 PNG/SVG charts, 5 vector PDF paper figures, 1280×640 social preview, `<4 MB` WCAG 2.2 AA Interactive HTML, CSV/TSV/XLSX/XLS/MD/TXT, deterministic `.json.gz`/`.jsonl.gz`, `RANKING.md`, and gitignored `.sqlite`/`.json`/`.jsonl`/`build/` directory PDF.
- `rag/query.py`, `mcp_server/server.py` — Offline Porter-stemmed SQLite FTS5 Hybrid RAG (`100.0% MRR@5`, auto-builds DB on fresh clones) and zero-dependency dual-framed 10-tool stdio MCP server.
- `lean/`, `palomar/PalomarChallenge.lean` — Zero-Mathlib Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal invariant suite (**103 audited theorems** across 6 independent kernels + live negative kernel rejection via `scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh`, `0` `sorry` in `lean/`, constructive axioms `⊆ [propext, Quot.sound]`).
- `paper/main.tex`, `paper/refs.bib`, `scripts/build_paper.py` — 10-page Tectonic AMS-LaTeX white paper (`dist/Donahue_2026_unsolved_problems_mega_atlas.pdf`) + deterministic clean-room `dist/arxiv_submission.tar.gz`.
- `reference/scoring_oracle.py`, `tests/`, `scripts/run_mutation_audit.py`, `scripts/benchmark_atlas.py` — 50-digit Decimal/Fraction oracle, Hypothesis property suite, differential/metamorphic/golden/negative tests, mutation testing (`6/6`), and 10-iteration warmed benchmarks.
- `autoresearch/evaluate.py` — **STRICTLY IMMUTABLE** Karpathy-style evaluation oracle (`AQS = 97.99`). **NEVER MODIFY THIS FILE.**

## 2. Canonical Commands (`justfile`)

```bash
just setup       # Create .venv and install editable + dev deps
just build       # Regenerate charts, exports, FAIR JSONs, llms-full.txt & checksums
just test        # Run full pytest suite (functional, Hypothesis, differential, MCP, FAIR)
just lint        # Run ruff check
just typecheck   # Run mypy
just mutate      # Run 6-mutant semantic mutation audit (requires 100% kill rate)
just bench       # Run 10-iteration warmed benchmarks -> docs/benchmarks.md
just lean        # Build Lean 4.35.0 suite, audit all 103 axioms & verify README parity
just paper       # Compile AMS-LaTeX PDF (0 overfull), clean-room arXiv tarball & verify 12 citations
just audit       # Run audit_atlas.py, forensic_audit.py, publish_zenodo.py --dry-run & evaluate.py
just reproduce   # End-to-end build + test + lean + paper + checksum verification
```

## 3. Non-Negotiable Hard Rules (Build Standard v1.2.0 R1–R8)

- **R1 (No friction):** Zero branch protection, zero required status checks, zero git hooks, zero commit/tag signing. CI is purely informational.
- **R2 (Trunk workflow):** Commit and push straight to `main`. No PRs, no feature branches. Use GitHub Issues for discussion and review.
- **R3 (No auto-merge/bot PRs):** No Dependabot, Renovate, or bot PR files.
- **R4 (No PR templates):** `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` is banned. Keep only issue templates in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`.
- **R5 (Lean & Hygiene):** Keep all git-tracked files strictly `< 5 MB` (`A24`). Keep `lean/**/*.lean` 100% free of `sorry`, `admit`, `native_decide`, and custom `axiom` (`palomar/PalomarChallenge.lean` holds the `sorry`-only Palomar contract outside `lean/`).
- **R6 (Immutability):** Never modify `autoresearch/evaluate.py` during research or hardening loops.
- **R7 (No fabricated claims):** Never fabricate DOIs, peer-review status, benchmark timings, or legal entities (author affiliation is strictly `Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA` — never assert an unformed LLC).
- **R8 (Exact 10 Finding Classes):** Every audit, review, erratum, and issue classifies findings strictly into:
  `bug`, `error`, `issue`, `problem`, `concern`, `dilemma`, `conflict`, `gap`, `hole`, `blindspot`.

## 4. Honest Epistemic Boundaries

1. Lean 4.35.0 verifies internal scoring, quadrant/era, taxonomy, graph handshaking, deduplication, AutoResearch ratchet, gradient/margin, NonVacuity, and AdversarialTests invariants ONLY — **0 / 1,900 overarching open problems are solved or retired**.
2. Quantitative difficulty/tractability/impact/interdisciplinarity scores are disclosed AI-assisted editorial estimates, not peer-reviewed measurements.
3. All 12 Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof claims remain officially unretired pending human-readable proofs and community consensus.

# Epistemic Verification Architecture & Boundaries (`v2.6.0`)

**Author:** Alexander Stephen Donahue (`Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA` · ORCID [`0009-0006-8168-9648`](https://orcid.org/0009-0006-8168-9648))

Every artifact in this repository belongs explicitly to one of **five strictly separated verification tiers**. Nothing from a lower tier is ever presented as a higher tier.

| Tier | Label | What Is Verified | Tooling / Proof Engine | Explicit Boundary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Tier 1** | `[kernel-checked]` | **103** Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal theorems (`Scoring`, `Quadrants`, `Taxonomy`, `GraphInvariants`, `AutoResearchInvariants`, `LayerGradients`, `NonVacuity`, `AdversarialTests`, `PalomarSolution`), `0` `sorry` in `lean/`, `0` `native_decide`, axioms strictly `⊆ [propext, Quot.sound]`, plus live negative kernel rejection. | `lake build` + 6 independent kernels (`lean`, `leanchecker --fresh`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`, `con-ron`) via `scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh` | Certifies internal scoring/taxonomy/graph/ratchet invariants, non-vacuity & false-variant refutations **ONLY**. Proves **0 / 1,900** cataloged open problems. |
| **Tier 2** | `[program-audited]` | `1,900` unique rows (`48` cols), 100% JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 valid, `1` biconnected component (`5,808` edges, `0` APs, `0` bridges, `0` dangling links), 50-digit `Decimal` oracle parity (`2,000+` cases), Hypothesis (`1,000` ex.), `6/6` mutation kill rate, `100.0% MRR@5` RAG, `AQS=97.99`, 10-tool MCP (clamped & validated), `0` overfull hboxes in AMS-LaTeX PDF, `12/12` live HTTP/DOI citations (`0` Crossref retractions), DigiCert RFC 3161 `.tsr` timestamp, Track B Antihydra finite bigint run (`5,000` steps). | `pytest`, `hypothesis`, `reference/scoring_oracle.py`, `scripts/run_mutation_audit.py`, `scripts/audit_atlas.py`, `scripts/forensic_audit.py`, `scripts/build_paper.py`, `scripts/check_citations.py`, `autoresearch/evaluate.py`, `openssl ts` | Verifies software, schema, cryptographic digests, and finite computation; proves no asymptotic conjectures. |
| **Tier 3** | `[registry-indexed]` | `925` primary-registry-indexed problems + `12` Fall/Nov 2026 AI proof claims (`ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026`) + `11` disputed human claims (`disputed-human-claim`). | Primary registries (`ProofAtlas`, `Erdős DB`, `Clay CMI`, `Kourovka`, `Kirby`, `NAE`, `WHO`, `IPCC`, etc.) | Point-in-time snapshot as of **November 25, 2026**; all 12 AI claims remain officially unretired. |
| **Tier 4** | `[editorial-estimate]` | Integer `1–10` rubric scores (`difficulty_score`, `tractability_2050`, `civilizational_impact`, `interdisciplinarity_index`) and `952` `ai-assisted-editorial-synthesis` entries. | Solo human curation with disclosed AI assistance (`docs/AI_DISCLOSURE.md`) | Falsifiable editorial estimates — NOT peer-reviewed empirical measurements. |
| **Tier 5** | `[open-conjecture]` | All `1,900` overarching Atlas open problems (including the parent IDs of all 12 companion archive entries in `0thernes-research-archive`). | Open scientific / mathematical frontier | **0 / 1,900 overarching Atlas problems are retired.** |

See [`docs/statement-fidelity.md`](docs/statement-fidelity.md) for the signed-off 19-row Lean-vs-Python fidelity matrix and [`CLAIMS.md`](CLAIMS.md) for exact verification commands and refutation conditions.

## FILE: LIMITATIONS.md — Known Limitations & Literal vs. Metaphor Table
================================================================================

# Known Limitations & Scope Boundaries

Per **Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0 (B41)** and the **Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3**, every known limitation, platform caveat, methodological bias, and literal-vs-metaphor boundary is stated plainly below.

## 1. Epistemic & Methodological Limitations

1. **Editorial Rubric Subjectivity:** The `1–10` ratings (`difficulty_score`, `tractability_2050`, `civilizational_impact`, `interdisciplinarity_index`) are curated AI-assisted editorial estimates by a solo independent researcher, NOT multi-rater peer-reviewed consensus scores. They should be treated as explicit, editable, falsifiable hypotheses (`src/v2_data/`).
2. **Disciplinary Registry Skew:** Pure Mathematics (`514` problems, `27.1%`) has deep historical registries (`ProofAtlas`, `Erdős Problems`, `Clay Millennium`, `Kourovka`, `Kirby`), whereas emerging engineering, design, and humanities frontiers lack centralized problem registries. Accordingly, `952 / 1,900` records carry the explicit flag `ai-assisted-editorial-synthesis` rather than `primary-registry-indexed`.
3. **Volatility of Fall–November 2026 AI Proof Claims:** The `12` problems flagged `ai-claim-under-audit-nov2026` (including `NT-001` Riemann Hypothesis, `NT-002` GRH, and `ANL-001` 3D Navier–Stokes) reflect a point-in-time snapshot as of **November 25, 2026**. Even where Lean multi-kernel certification succeeded (Alpöge/Claude RH/GRH archive on Nov 21, 2026), lack of a complete human-readable paper and pending Clay CMI/community evaluation keep all 12 officially unretired.
4. **No External Peer Review:** Neither this dataset, the AMS-LaTeX white paper, nor the 12 cross-referenced companion archive entries in `0thernes-research-archive` have undergone external journal peer review.
5. **Formal Verification Scope Boundary:** Lean 4.35.0 (`103` theorems across 6 kernels) certifies ONLY discrete formula bounds, monotonicity, taxonomy partitions, finite graph handshaking, deduplication monotonicity, AutoResearch keep/discard ratchet properties, gradient/margin bounds, concrete NonVacuity witnesses, and constructive AdversarialTests refutations. It proves **ZERO** of the `1,900` open problems themselves (`0 / 1,900` retired). IEEE-754 `log1p(degree)` calculations are checked differentially against our 50-digit `Decimal` reference oracle (`reference/scoring_oracle.py`), not inside Lean.
6. **Track B Antihydra Pilot Is Finite Only:** `research/runs/LOG-002_antihydra_pilot/` evaluates `5,000` exact bigint steps (`a_0=8`) and `99` seeds (`a_0 ∈ [2, 100]` to `2,000` steps). It provides zero proof regarding asymptotic halting of Antihydra or `BB(6)`.

## 2. Platform, Runtime & Packaging Caveats

- **Tested Platforms:** Local execution verified on Windows 11 (`x86_64`, Python 3.12.10, Lean 4.35.0, Tectonic 0.15). GitHub Actions CI executes across `ubuntu-latest`, `macos-latest`, and `windows-latest`.
- **`lake comparator` Sandbox (`bubblewrap`):** Full `bwrap`-sandboxed 6-kernel verification runs via `bash scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh` on Linux (`ubuntu-latest` CI), exporting `PalomarChallenge` to `/tmp/PalomarChallenge.export` and passing `--challenge-from-export` to `lake comparator --paranoid`; Windows lacks Linux `bwrap` user namespaces, so local Windows verification replays `lean`, `leanchecker --fresh`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche --verified`, `con-ron --verified`, and the live negative kernel rejection test directly while Linux CI runs the full sandboxed 6-kernel comparator including `lean4lean`.
- **Optional 168-Page Chrome Directory PDF:** `src/v2_export_all.py` builds the optional 168-page directory PDF into gitignored `build/` only when Chrome/Edge is installed (`--skip-pdf` skips it cleanly on headless CI; the canonical scholarly PDF is `dist/Donahue_2026_unsolved_problems_mega_atlas.pdf` compiled by Tectonic).
- **Locale Scope:** All text, search tokenization (`porter unicode61`), and UI copy target **English (`en-US`, UTF-8)** only.

## 3. Literal vs. Metaphor Boundary Table

| Term Used in Atlas / Paper | Literal Technical Meaning | What It Does NOT Claim |
|---|---|---|
| **Biconnected Connectome / Knowledge Graph** | An undirected NetworkX graph (`1,900` vertices, `5,808` edges) with `nx.is_biconnected(G) == True` (`0` articulation points, `0` bridges). | Does NOT claim biological neural anatomy or causal proof-reduction between every adjacent pair. |
| **Keystone Domino Hub** | A vertex with high PageRank, graph degree, and ≥ 3 adjacent foreign Macro-Pillars (`adjacent_pillars_count >= 3`). | Does NOT prove that solving the hub mathematically implies solving all neighbors. |
| **Hardness–Tractability Chasm / Gradient (`D − T`)** | Signed integer difference `difficulty_score - tractability_2050 ∈ [-9, +9]`. | Not a physical PDE gradient or thermodynamic potential. |
| **Multi-Layer Reality Stack (`8 Substrates × 7 Layers`)** | A deterministic 2D taxonomic lookup table mapping each of the 28 Superdomains to one Substrate and one Abstraction Layer (`L0..L6`). | Not a claim of ontological reductionism across physics, biology, and ethics. |
| **AutoResearch Ratchet** | Automated local evaluation against immutable `autoresearch/evaluate.py` keeping changes only when hard gates pass and `AQS` strictly increases. | Not autonomous discovery of mathematical proofs of open conjectures. |
| **Verified / Formalized** | Machine-checked in Lean 4.35.0 across 6 kernels for the 103 structural invariant & adversarial-refutation theorems in `lean/`, OR schema/parity-checked in Python for dataset properties. | NEVER means that any of the 1,900 cataloged open problems are solved or peer-reviewed. |

# Lean 4.35.0 Statement-Fidelity Audit Matrix (`v2.6.0`)

Per the **Defensible Independent AI Research Playbook v1.3 (Pass 4 — Statement-Fidelity Audit)**,
this document audits every single theorem group in `lean/` against the paper (`paper/main.tex`)
and Python runtime (`src/v2_loader.py`, `src/v2_schema.py`, `autoresearch/evaluate.py`, `rag/query.py`),
stating exact fidelity status and any intentional modeling abstraction.

## 1. Module-to-Runtime Correspondence Table

| # | Lean Module & Theorem(s) | Paper / Python Definition | Fidelity Status | Exact Scope Boundary / Divergence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Scoring.ageScoreCentis_*` (4 thms) | `min(100.0, max(0.0, age_years / 3.0))` (`src/v2_loader.py::compute_css_score`) | Exact integer centis | Integer floor `(age * 100) / 3` vs IEEE-754 float; differs by `< 0.01` point (`0` diffs > `0.01` across 2,000 oracle checks). |
| 2 | `Scoring.css_weights_sum`, `cssBps_*` (9 thms) | `0.40*diff + 0.30*cent + 0.20*age + 0.10*(100-tract)` (`src/v2_loader.py::compute_css_score`) | Exact linear bps; `ln` abstracted | Transcendental `min(100, 25*ln(1+deg))` abstracted as bounded `cent100 <= 100`; verified differentially against 50-digit `Decimal` oracle (`reference/scoring_oracle.py`). |
| 3 | `Scoring.titan_weights_sum`, `titanCentis_*` (6 thms) | `0.35*d + 0.35*i + 0.20*r + 0.10*min(10, 2.5*ln(1+deg))` (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact linear centis; `ln` abstracted | Same `ln(1+deg)` boundary checked via `reference/scoring_oracle.py`. |
| 4 | `Scoring.leverageTenths_*` (3 thms) | `(impact * tractability_2050) / 10.0` (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Zero divergence (`impact * tract` in tenths). |
| 5 | `Quadrants.classify_eq_Q{1..4}_iff`, `classify_exhaustive`, `highImpact_preserved`, `highTract_preserved`, `Q1_leverage_ge_56` (8 thms) | `classify_quadrant(impact, tract)` (`src/v2_loader.py::classify_quadrant`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Zero divergence; thresholds `impact >= 8` and `tract >= 7` match verbatim. |
| 6 | `Quadrants.computeEra_*` (3 thms) | `compute_era(year)` (`src/v2_schema.py::compute_era`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Zero divergence across all 6 cutoffs (`500, 1800, 1900, 1970, 2000`). |
| 7 | `Taxonomy.pillar_count_eq_8`, `superdomain_count_eq_28`, `pillar_partition_*`, `all*_complete`, `pillarOf_surjective`, `cross_pillar_implies_cross_superdomain` (8 thms) | `MACRO_PILLARS` (8), `SUPERDOMAIN_TO_PILLAR` (28) (`src/v2_schema.py::SUPERDOMAIN_TO_PILLAR`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Exact `[5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3]` partition verified identically. |
| 8 | `GraphInvariants.handshaking_lemma` | `sum(deg(v)) == 2 * |E|` on `nx.Graph()` (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact finite-graph theorem | Holds universally for all finite nodup vertex lists & closed edge lists; biconnectivity (`0` APs, `0` bridges) checked programmatically by NetworkX. |
| 9 | `GraphInvariants.cross_pillar_le_cross_superdomain`, `cross_superdomain_le_total`, `edge_hierarchy` | `cross_pillar_edges <= cross_superdomain_edges <= total_graph_edges` (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Zero divergence (`1,084 <= 2,076 <= 5,808`). |
| 10 | `GraphInvariants.dedupBy_length_le` | First-occurrence deduplication (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact cardinality bound | Proves `|dedup| <= |raw|` (`1,900 <= 1,912`). |
| 11 | `AutoResearchInvariants.aqs_*` (6 thms) | `aqs_score` in immutable `autoresearch/evaluate.py::evaluate_all` | Exact integer bps | Weights `25+25+20+15+15=100`, bounds `[0, 10000]`, strict monotonicity. |
| 12 | `AutoResearchInvariants.failed_gates_always_discard`, `shouldKeep_iff`, `updateBest_*` (4 thms) | Karpathy keep/discard protocol (`autoresearch/program.md`) | Exact formal policy | Guarantees failed hard gates ALWAYS discard regardless of candidate score. |
| 13 | `AutoResearchInvariants.metricDelta_self`, `metricDelta_antisymm` (2 thms) | `compare_two_problems` deltas (`rag/query.py::compare_two_problems`) | Exact integer antisymmetry | Float differences verified to `1e-6` in `test_pairwise_comparator_antisymmetry`. |
| 14 | `LayerGradients.substrate_count_eq_8`, `layer_count_eq_7`, `allSubstrates_complete`, `layerIndex_le_6` (4 thms) | `SUBSTRATE_CLASSES` (8), `ABSTRACTION_LAYERS` (7) (`src/v2_loader.py::SUBSTRATE_CLASSES`) | Exact 1-to-1 isomorphism | Zero divergence. |
| 15 | `LayerGradients.hardnessTractGradient_*`, `cssTitanMarginBps_bounds` (5 thms) | `difficulty_score - tractability_2050`, `css_score - 10 * titan_index` (`src/v2_loader.py::load_v2_master`) | Exact integer / bps bounds | Exact `[-9, +9]` and `[-10000, +10000]` bounds. |
| 16 | `LayerGradients.bridgeMarginBps_*`, `adjacent_pillars_lt_8`, `marginRole_exhaustive`, `apexKeystone_requires_3_adjacent` (5 thms) | `bridge_margin_ratio`, `adjacent_pillars_count`, `classify_margin_role` (`src/v2_loader.py::classify_margin_role`) | Exact bps correspondence | `3000 bps` matches `bridge_ratio >= 0.30`. |
| 17 | `NonVacuity.*` (12 thms) | Concrete inhabitants + exact `autoresearch/results.tsv` trace (`8026→8193→9559→9799`) + sharp negative boundaries | Non-vacuity proof | Proves zero hypothesis bundles across M1–M6 are unsatisfiable. |
| 18 | `AdversarialTests.*` (10 thms) | Constructive kernel-checked refutations (`¬P`) of deliberately false / off-by-one variants across M1–M6 + live negative kernel rejection | Adversarial test (Playbook Item 12) | Complements 6/6 (100%) Python semantic mutation kill rate. |
| 19 | `PalomarSolution.m1..m8`, `prove_all_mega_atlas_invariants` (9 thms) | `palomar/PalomarChallenge.lean` contract | Exact comparator identity | Verified via `scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh` (`leanchecker --fresh`, `lake check --paranoid`, `lake comparator --paranoid`) across all 6 kernels. |

## 2. What Is Explicitly NOT Formalized in Lean

1. **None of the 1,900 cataloged open scientific or mathematical problems are proved in Lean.**
2. **Transcendental `ln(1 + degree)` floating-point calls** are verified differentially against 50-digit `Decimal` in `reference/scoring_oracle.py`, not inside Lean.
3. **NetworkX PageRank, betweenness, modularity, and biconnectivity** are audited programmatically via `tests/test_mega_atlas.py` and `scripts/forensic_audit.py`.
4. **SQLite FTS5 Porter-stemming BM25 ranking** is audited via the immutable 25-query Gold Benchmark (`100.0% MRR@5`) and negative/metamorphic tests.

## FILE: lean/Challenge.lean — Formal Lean 4.35.0 Challenge Specification (M1-M8)

module
-- SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
-- Copyright (c) 2026 Alexander Stephen Donahue

public import MegaAtlasProofs

/-!
# Formal Challenge Specification (`M1`–`M8`)

Clean exported theorem specification contract for independent 6-kernel verification
(`lean`, `leanchecker --fresh`, `leanchecker-paranoid`, `lean4lean`, `nanoda_bin`, `con-leche`,
`con-ron` via `scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh`).
All proofs live in `Solution.lean` and `MegaAtlasProofs.*`.
-/

namespace MegaAtlasProofs.Challenge

open MegaAtlasProofs.Scoring
open MegaAtlasProofs.Quadrants
open MegaAtlasProofs.Taxonomy
open MegaAtlasProofs.GraphInvariants
open MegaAtlasProofs.AutoResearchInvariants
open MegaAtlasProofs.LayerGradients
open MegaAtlasProofs.NonVacuity

@[expose] public section

def M1_ScoringInvariants : Prop :=
  (40 + 30 + 20 + 10 = 100) ∧
  (35 + 35 + 20 + 10 = 100) ∧
  (∀ ageYears : Nat, ageScoreCentis ageYears ≤ 10000) ∧
  (∀ ageYears : Nat, 300 ≤ ageYears → ageScoreCentis ageYears = 10000) ∧
  (∀ d c a t : Nat, d ≤ 100 → c ≤ 100 → a ≤ 100 → cssBps d c a t ≤ 10000) ∧
  (∀ d c a t : Nat, 10 ≤ d → 5 ≤ c → 550 ≤ cssBps d c a t) ∧
  (∀ d₁ d₂ c a t : Nat, d₁ ≤ d₂ → cssBps d₁ c a t ≤ cssBps d₂ c a t) ∧
  (∀ d c a t₁ t₂ : Nat, t₁ ≤ t₂ → cssBps d c a t₂ ≤ cssBps d c a t₁) ∧
  (∀ d i r degT : Nat, 1 ≤ d → d ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ i → i ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ 10 → degT ≤ 100 →
    90 ≤ titanCentis d i r degT ∧ titanCentis d i r degT ≤ 1000) ∧
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, 1 ≤ imp → imp ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ tr → tr ≤ 10 →
    1 ≤ leverageTenths imp tr ∧ leverageTenths imp tr ≤ 100)

def M2_QuadrantAndEraInvariants : Prop :=
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q1 ↔ imp ≥ 8 ∧ tr ≥ 7) ∧
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q2 ↔ imp ≥ 8 ∧ tr < 7) ∧
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q3 ↔ imp < 8 ∧ tr ≥ 7) ∧
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q4 ↔ imp < 8 ∧ tr < 7) ∧
  (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q1 → 56 ≤ leverageTenths imp tr) ∧
  (∀ y₁ y₂ : Int, y₁ ≤ y₂ → eraRank (computeEra y₁) ≤ eraRank (computeEra y₂))

def M3_TaxonomyInvariants : Prop :=
  allPillars.length = 8 ∧
  allSuperdomains.length = 28 ∧
  allPillars.map (fun p => (superdomainsIn p).length) = [5, 3, 3, 3, 3, 4, 4, 3] ∧
  (∀ s : Superdomain, s ∈ allSuperdomains) ∧
  (∀ p : MacroPillar, p ∈ allPillars) ∧
  (∀ p : MacroPillar, ∃ s : Superdomain, pillarOf s = p) ∧
  (∀ s₁ s₂ : Superdomain, pillarOf s₁ ≠ pillarOf s₂ → s₁ ≠ s₂)

def M4_GraphAndDedupInvariants : Prop :=
  (∀ (V : Type) [DecidableEq V] (vs : List V) (_ : vs.Nodup) (es : List (Edge V)),
    (∀ e ∈ es, e.u ∈ vs ∧ e.v ∈ vs) →
    sumNat (vs.map (fun x => degreeOf x es)) = 2 * es.length) ∧
  (∀ (V : Type) (sd : V → Superdomain) (es : List (Edge V)),
    crossPillarCount sd es ≤ crossSuperdomainCount sd es ∧
    crossSuperdomainCount sd es ≤ es.length) ∧
  (∀ (α β : Type) [DecidableEq β] (key : α → β) (seen : List β) (xs : List α),
    (dedupBy key seen xs).length ≤ xs.length)

def M5_AutoResearchRatchetInvariants : Prop :=
  (25 + 25 + 20 + 15 + 15 = 100) ∧
  (∀ s r p g f : Nat, s ≤ 100 → r ≤ 100 → p ≤ 100 → g ≤ 100 → f ≤ 100 → aqsBps s r p g f ≤ 10000) ∧
  (∀ bestScore candScore : Nat, shouldKeep false bestScore candScore = false) ∧
  (∀ gates bestScore candScore, shouldKeep gates bestScore candScore = true ↔ gates = true ∧ bestScore < candScore) ∧
  (∀ gates bestScore candScore, bestScore ≤ updateBest gates bestScore candScore) ∧
  (∀ a : Int, metricDelta a a = 0) ∧
  (∀ a b : Int, metricDelta a b = - metricDelta b a)

def M6_LayerGradientMarginInvariants : Prop :=
  allSubstrates.length = 8 ∧
  allLayers.length = 7 ∧
  (∀ s : SubstrateClass, s ∈ allSubstrates) ∧
  (∀ l : AbstractionLayer, layerIndex l ≤ 6) ∧
  (∀ d t : Int, 1 ≤ d → d ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ t → t ≤ 10 →
    -9 ≤ hardnessTractGradient d t ∧ hardnessTractGradient d t ≤ 9) ∧
  (∀ c t : Int, 0 ≤ c → c ≤ 10000 → 0 ≤ t → t ≤ 1000 →
    -10000 ≤ cssTitanMarginBps c t ∧ cssTitanMarginBps c t ≤ 10000) ∧
  (∀ cp deg : Nat, cp ≤ deg → bridgeMarginBps cp deg ≤ 10000) ∧
  (∀ adj crossSD bps : Nat, classifyMarginRole adj crossSD bps = .apexKeystone ↔ adj ≥ 3)

def M7_NonVacuityCertificate : Prop :=
  (cssBps 100 100 55 40 = 8700 ∧ ageScoreCentis 299 < 10000) ∧
  (classifyQuadrant 8 7 = .Q1 ∧ classifyQuadrant 8 6 = .Q2 ∧
   classifyQuadrant 7 7 = .Q3 ∧ classifyQuadrant 7 6 = .Q4) ∧
  (computeEra (-500) = .antiquity ∧ computeEra 2000 = .twentyFirstC) ∧
  (sumNat (sampleVertices.map (fun x => degreeOf x sampleEdges)) = 2 * sampleEdges.length ∧
   crossPillarCount sampleSuperdomain sampleEdges = 2) ∧
  (shouldKeep true 8026 8026 = false ∧ shouldKeep true 8026 8193 = true ∧
   shouldKeep true 9559 9799 = true ∧ shouldKeep false 9799 10000 = false) ∧
  (classifyMarginRole 3 5 4000 = .apexKeystone ∧
   classifyMarginRole 2 3 3000 = .transPillarMargin ∧
   classifyMarginRole 2 3 2999 = .intraPillarBridge ∧
   classifyMarginRole 0 0 0 = .coreSpecialist)

def M8_AdversarialRefutations : Prop :=
  (¬ (∀ d c a t : Nat, d ≤ 100 → c ≤ 100 → a ≤ 100 → cssBps d c a t < 10000)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ age : Nat, 299 ≤ age → ageScoreCentis age = 10000)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ d i r degT : Nat, 1 ≤ d → d ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ i → i ≤ 10 → 1 ≤ r → r ≤ 10 → degT ≤ 100 →
      titanCentis d i r degT < 1000)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q1 → 57 ≤ leverageTenths imp tr)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ imp tr : Nat, classifyQuadrant imp tr = .Q2 → 56 ≤ leverageTenths imp tr)) ∧
  (¬ (allSuperdomains.length = 27)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ (vs : List Nat), vs.Nodup → ∀ (es : List (Edge Nat)),
      (∀ e ∈ es, e.u ∈ vs ∧ e.v ∈ vs) →
      sumNat (vs.map (fun x => degreeOf x es)) = 3 * es.length)) ∧
  (¬ (∃ best cand : Nat, shouldKeep false best cand = true)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ adj crossSD bps : Nat, adj ≥ 2 → classifyMarginRole adj crossSD bps = .apexKeystone)) ∧
  (¬ (∀ adj crossSD bps : Nat, adj ≥ 1 → bps ≥ 2999 → classifyMarginRole adj crossSD bps = .transPillarMargin))

def AllMegaAtlasInvariants : Prop :=
  M1_ScoringInvariants ∧
  M2_QuadrantAndEraInvariants ∧
  M3_TaxonomyInvariants ∧
  M4_GraphAndDedupInvariants ∧
  M5_AutoResearchRatchetInvariants ∧
  M6_LayerGradientMarginInvariants ∧
  M7_NonVacuityCertificate ∧
  M8_AdversarialRefutations

end

end MegaAtlasProofs.Challenge

## FILE: REPLICATION.md — Clean-Clone Replication Protocol & Log
================================================================================

# Independent Clean-Clone Replication Protocol & Log (`v2.6.0`)

Per **Build Standard for LLMs v1.2.0 (B43, B44)**, this document provides step-by-step instructions to independently replicate every quantitative result, formal proof, chart, white paper PDF, and benchmark from a fresh git clone — plus the recorded verification log of an actual clean-directory replication run.

## 1. Prerequisites

- Python `3.10+` (`3.12` tested)
- `git`
- Lean 4 via `elan` (`lean/lean-toolchain` pins `leanprover/lean4:v4.35.0` automatically)
- Tectonic (`>= 0.15`) for AMS-LaTeX PDF & clean-room arXiv tarball compilation
- Optional: `just` command runner (every command also runs directly with `python` / `lake`)

## 2. Exact Clean-Clone Replication Steps

```bash
# 1. Clone cleanly into an isolated directory
git clone https://github.com/0thernes/unsolved-problems-mega-atlas.git mega-atlas-repl
cd mega-atlas-repl

# 2. Verify tracked cryptographic manifests before executing any build script
python -c "import hashlib, pathlib; lines=[l.strip().split(None,1) for l in pathlib.Path('CHECKSUMS.sha256').read_text().splitlines() if l.strip()]; assert all(hashlib.sha256(pathlib.Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for h,p in lines); print(f'OK: {len(lines)} checksums')"

# 3. Install dependencies in a fresh virtual environment
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe  |  Linux/macOS: .venv/bin/python
.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip
.venv/bin/python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"

# 4. Run full verification suite (auto-builds SQLite FTS5 DB on demand!)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ -v
.venv/bin/python examples/quickstart_demo.py
.venv/bin/python scripts/audit_atlas.py --check-lean
.venv/bin/python scripts/forensic_audit.py
.venv/bin/python scripts/run_mutation_audit.py
.venv/bin/python scripts/check_readme_axioms.py
.venv/bin/python autoresearch/evaluate.py --verify-gates

# 5. Independently verify Lean 4.35.0 formal proofs (103 theorems)
cd lean && lake clean && lake build && lake env lean MegaAtlasProofs/VerifyAxioms.lean
# Compare verbatim against ../results/lean_axioms.txt (zero diff)
cd ..
# On Linux with bubblewrap (single-source 6-kernel replay + Palomar comparator):
bash scripts/verify_lean_six_kernels.sh

# 6. Independently compile AMS-LaTeX white paper & clean-room arXiv tarball
.venv/bin/python scripts/build_paper.py
.venv/bin/python scripts/check_citations.py
```

## 3. Expected Exact Tolerances

- **Dataset cardinality & topology:** Exact (`1,900` problems, `48` columns, `5,808` edges, `0` articulation points, `0` bridges, `0` dangling links).
- **Lean 4.35.0 axioms:** Byte-exact match against `results/lean_axioms.txt` (`103` lines, axioms `⊆ [propext, Quot.sound]`, zero `Classical.choice`).
- **Differential scoring oracle:** `<= 0.01` rounding tolerance across all `1,900` atlas records + `2,000` randomized inputs.
- **RAG & AutoResearch:** Exact `100.00% MRR@5` (`25/25` top-1), `AQS = 97.99`, `hard_gates = PASS`.
- **Mutation kill rate:** Exact `100.0%` (`6/6` mutants killed).
- **AMS-LaTeX PDF:** `0` overfull hboxes, `0` undefined references/citations, `12/12` live citations (`0` Crossref retractions).
